# Gazebo 仿真环境

## 核心概念

Gazebo 是 ROS 生态中最主流的机器人仿真平台，提供物理引擎、传感器模拟、环境渲染等功能。仿真环境使得机器人算法可以在虚拟世界中进行开发和验证，大幅降低硬件开发成本和安全风险。Gazebo Fortress/Harmonic（Ignition 系列）是 ROS2 的推荐仿真器，取代了经典的 Gazebo Classic。

仿真在机器人开发中的价值体现在三个维度：**安全性**（避免真实硬件损坏）、**效率**（可并行运行数百个实例）和**可重复性**（相同条件下可精确复现结果）。

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph Gazebo 架构
        SDF[SDF 世界文件] --> PHYSICS[物理引擎 DART/ODE]
        SDF --> RENDER[渲染引擎 OGRE2]
        SDF --> SENSORS[传感器仿真]
        PHYSICS --> ROBOT[机器人模型]
        SENSORS --> LIDAR[激光雷达]
        SENSORS --> CAMERA[相机]
        SENSORS --> IMU_SIM[IMU]
        ROBOT -->|ros_gz_bridge| ROS[ROS2 话题]
        LIDAR --> ROS
        CAMERA --> ROS
    end
```

| 仿真器          | 物理引擎    | ROS2 集成     | GPU 渲染 | 多机器人 | 适用场景     |
| --------------- | ----------- | ------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------ |
| Gazebo Harmonic | DART/Bullet | ros_gz_bridge | 支持     | 优秀     | 通用仿真     |
| Isaac Sim       | PhysX       | 原生          | 必需     | 优秀     | 深度学习训练 |
| Webots          | ODE         | ros2 包       | 可选     | 良好     | 教育科研     |
| PyBullet        | Bullet      | 自定义        | 可选     | 良好     | 快速原型     |
| MuJoCo          | 自研        | 自定义        | 支持     | 良好     | 接触丰富任务 |

## SDF 世界与模型定义

SDF（Simulation Description Format）是 Gazebo 的世界和模型描述格式，比 URDF 更强大，支持光照、传感器噪声模型、关节控制插件等仿真专属特性。

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<sdf version="1.8">
  <world name="warehouse">
    <physics name="1ms" type="dart">
      <max_step_size>0.001</max_step_size>
      <real_time_factor>1.0</real_time_factor>
    </physics>

    <light type="directional" name="sun">
      <cast_shadows>true</cast_shadows>
      <pose>0 0 10 0 0 0</pose>
      <diffuse>0.8 0.8 0.8 1</diffuse>
      <specular>0.2 0.2 0.2 1</specular>
      <direction>-0.5 0.1 -0.9</direction>
    </light>

    <model name="ground_plane">
      <static>true</static>
      <link name="link">
        <collision name="collision">
          <geometry><plane><normal>0 0 1</normal></plane></geometry>
        </collision>
        <visual name="visual">
          <geometry><plane><normal>0 0 1</normal><size>100 100</size></plane></geometry>
        </visual>
      </link>
    </model>

    <include>
      <uri>model://my_robot</uri>
      <name>robot1</name>
      <pose>0 0 0.1 0 0 0</pose>
    </include>

    <model name="obstacle_box">
      <static>true</static>
      <pose>3 2 0.5 0 0 0</pose>
      <link name="link">
        <collision name="collision">
          <geometry><box><size>1 1 1</size></box></geometry>
        </collision>
        <visual name="visual">
          <geometry><box><size>1 1 1</size></box></geometry>
        </visual>
      </link>
    </model>

    <plugin filename="gz-sim-physics-system" name="gz::sim::systems::Physics"/>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-scene-broadcaster-system" name="gz::sim::systems::SceneBroadcaster"/>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-sensors-system" name="gz::sim::systems::Sensors">
      <render_engine>ogre2</render_engine>
    </plugin>
  </world>
</sdf>
```

## 传感器仿真配置

Gazebo 支持丰富的传感器模型，包括激光雷达、RGB/深度相机、IMU、GPS 等，并能模拟噪声特性以贴近真实传感器行为。

```xml
<model name="my_robot">
  <link name="base_link">
    <sensor name="gpu_lidar" type="gpu_lidar">
      <pose>0.2 0 0.15 0 0 0</pose>
      <topic>/scan</topic>
      <update_rate>10</update_rate>
      <lidar>
        <scan>
          <horizontal>
            <samples>360</samples>
            <resolution>1</resolution>
            <min_angle>-3.14159</min_angle>
            <max_angle>3.14159</max_angle>
          </horizontal>
        </scan>
        <range>
          <min>0.12</min>
          <max>12.0</max>
          <resolution>0.01</resolution>
        </range>
        <noise>
          <type>gaussian</type>
          <mean>0.0</mean>
          <stddev>0.01</stddev>
        </noise>
      </lidar>
    </sensor>

    <sensor name="rgbd_camera" type="rgbd_camera">
      <pose>0.15 0 0.3 0 0 0</pose>
      <topic>/camera</topic>
      <update_rate>30</update_rate>
      <camera>
        <horizontal_fov>1.047</horizontal_fov>
        <image>
          <width>640</width>
          <height>480</height>
          <format>R8G8B8</format>
        </image>
        <clip>
          <near>0.1</near>
          <far>10</far>
        </clip>
        <depth_camera>
          <clip>
            <near>0.1</near>
            <far>10</far>
          </clip>
        </depth_camera>
        <noise>
          <type>gaussian</type>
          <mean>0</mean>
          <stddev>0.007</stddev>
        </noise>
      </camera>
    </sensor>

    <sensor name="imu_sensor" type="imu">
      <always_on>true</always_on>
      <update_rate>200</update_rate>
      <topic>/imu</topic>
      <imu>
        <angular_velocity>
          <x><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>0.0002</stddev></noise></x>
          <y><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>0.0002</stddev></noise></y>
          <z><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>0.0002</stddev></noise></z>
        </angular_velocity>
        <linear_acceleration>
          <x><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>0.017</stddev></noise></x>
          <y><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>0.017</stddev></noise></y>
          <z><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>0.017</stddev></noise></z>
        </linear_acceleration>
      </imu>
    </sensor>
  </link>
</model>
```

## ROS2-Gazebo 桥接

`ros_gz_bridge` 负责在 Gazebo 话题和 ROS2 话题之间建立双向数据桥接。桥接配置决定了哪些仿真数据可以被 ROS2 节点访问。

```python
from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import IncludeLaunchDescription, ExecuteProcess
from launch_ros.actions import Node
from launch.launch_description_sources import PythonLaunchDescriptionSource

def generate_launch_description():
    gz_sim = ExecuteProcess(
        cmd=['gz', 'sim', '-r', 'warehouse.sdf'],
        output='screen'
    )

    bridge = Node(
        package='ros_gz_bridge',
        executable='parameter_bridge',
        arguments=[
            '/scan@sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan[gz.msgs.LaserScan',
            '/camera/image@sensor_msgs/msg/Image[gz.msgs.Image',
            '/camera/depth@sensor_msgs/msg/Image[gz.msgs.Image',
            '/camera/camera_info@sensor_msgs/msg/CameraInfo[gz.msgs.CameraInfo',
            '/imu@sensor_msgs/msg/Imu[gz.msgs.IMU',
            '/cmd_vel@geometry_msgs/msg/Twist]gz.msgs.Twist',
            '/odom@nav_msgs/msg/Odometry[gz.msgs.Odometry',
            '/clock@rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock[gz.msgs.Clock',
        ],
        output='screen'
    )

    spawn_robot = Node(
        package='ros_gz_sim',
        executable='create',
        arguments=[
            '-name', 'my_robot',
            '-topic', '/robot_description',
            '-x', '0', '-y', '0', '-z', '0.1',
        ],
        output='screen'
    )

    return LaunchDescription([
        gz_sim,
        bridge,
        spawn_robot,
    ])
```

| 桥接方向 | 语法 | 数据流    | 示例       |
| -------- | ---- | --------- | ---------- |
| GZ→ROS2  | `[`  | 仿真→算法 | 传感器数据 |
| ROS2→GZ  | `]`  | 算法→仿真 | 控制指令   |
| 双向     | `@`  | 双向通信  | 服务调用   |

## 自动化测试与 CI 集成

仿真环境的核心价值之一是支持自动化测试。通过无头（headless）模式运行 Gazebo，可以在 CI/CD 流水线中自动验证机器人算法的正确性。

```python
import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from geometry_msgs.msg import PoseStamped
from nav_msgs.msg import Odometry
import numpy as np

class NavigationTest(Node):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__('navigation_test')

        self.goal_pub = self.create_publisher(
            PoseStamped, '/goal_pose', 10
        )

        self.odom_sub = self.create_subscription(
            Odometry, '/odom', self.odom_callback, 10
        )

        self.current_pose = None
        self.test_goals = [
            (2.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            (2.0, 2.0, 1.57),
            (0.0, 2.0, 3.14),
            (0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        ]
        self.current_goal_idx = 0
        self.test_results = []

        self.create_timer(1.0, self.run_test)

    def odom_callback(self, msg):
        self.current_pose = msg.pose.pose

    def run_test(self):
        if self.current_goal_idx >= len(self.test_goals):
            self.report_results()
            return

        goal = self.test_goals[self.current_goal_idx]

        if self.current_pose and self.is_goal_reached(goal):
            self.test_results.append({
                'goal': goal,
                'reached': True,
                'error': self.compute_error(goal)
            })
            self.current_goal_idx += 1
            if self.current_goal_idx < len(self.test_goals):
                self.send_goal(self.test_goals[self.current_goal_idx])
        elif not self.current_pose:
            self.send_goal(goal)

    def send_goal(self, goal):
        msg = PoseStamped()
        msg.header.frame_id = 'map'
        msg.header.stamp = self.get_clock().now().to_msg()
        msg.pose.position.x = goal[0]
        msg.pose.position.y = goal[1]
        self.goal_pub.publish(msg)

    def is_goal_reached(self, goal, threshold=0.3):
        dx = self.current_pose.position.x - goal[0]
        dy = self.current_pose.position.y - goal[1]
        return np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2) < threshold

    def compute_error(self, goal):
        dx = self.current_pose.position.x - goal[0]
        dy = self.current_pose.position.y - goal[1]
        return np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)

    def report_results(self):
        all_passed = all(r['reached'] for r in self.test_results)
        avg_error = np.mean([r['error'] for r in self.test_results])
        self.get_logger().info(
            f'测试完成: {"全部通过" if all_passed else "存在失败"}, '
            f'平均误差: {avg_error:.3f}m'
        )
```

## 小结

- Gazebo 提供物理仿真、传感器模拟和可视化渲染，是 ROS2 机器人开发的标准仿真平台
- SDF 格式比 URDF 更强大，支持世界定义、光照、传感器噪声等仿真特性
- 传感器仿真通过噪声模型模拟真实传感器行为，缩小 sim-to-real 差距
- ros_gz_bridge 实现 Gazebo 和 ROS2 之间的双向话题桥接
- 无头仿真模式支持 CI/CD 自动化测试，提升开发效率和代码质量
- 仿真环境的价值在于安全性、效率和可重复性的三重保障
